plugins.name: Fugs MultiTrack Audio EX
plugins.description: Unlimited independent BGM, BGS, ME, and SE tracks for RPG Maker MV and MZ, with fades, stem mixing, WebAudio effects, spatial audio, ducking, switch-gated commands, and SFX aliases. Core plus optional satellites.
features: Unlimited BGM / BGS / ME / SE tracks that run alongside RPG Maker MV's stock audio
Per-track volume, pan, pitch, fades, crossfades, pause/resume, and command chains
Synchronized stem mixing (syncplay) for layered intensity without restarting music
Optional WebAudio effect chains and named presets (cave, radio, combat, weather, and more)
Optional proximity / doppler spatial audio and pan sweeps
Optional ducking, sidechain compression, and tempo-synced pump
Optional switch-gated commands and SFX alias pools with humanizer jitter
Save/load snapshots, scene persistence, and a FugsAudio script API
In-editor playbook lives in FugsAudio0Docs.js — enable it in Plugin Manager
installation: Download Core (FugsMultiTrackAudioEX.js) plus the satellites you need. FugsAudio0Docs.js is recommended so Plugin Manager shows the full playbook.
Copy the files into your project's js/plugins folder.
In Plugin Manager, enable Core first, then Docs, then optional satellites top to bottom. Put FugsAudio7Compat after OcRam if you use it. Keep FugsAudio8Test off in shipped builds.
Do not enable the all-in-one bundle and satellites 2–7 at the same time.
Use Event → Plugin Command (play-bgm1 ThemeA 90 2) or the FugsAudio script API.

plugins.name: Fugs Master Volume
plugins.description: Set a sensible starting volume for your game and give players one master control for all audio, with optional control over RPG Maker's stock volume sliders.
features: Apply a developer-defined default volume when the game first starts
Add a saved master-volume control to the Options menu
Optionally hide the stock BGM, BGS, SE, and ME sliders
Customize slider labels and keyboard or mouse step sizes
Test volume settings with included console helpers
installation: Download FugsMasterVolume.js.
Place it in your project's js/plugins folder.
Add FugsMasterVolume in the Plugin Manager and turn it on.
Set the developer and player volume options to suit your game.

plugins.name: Fugs Only OGG MV
plugins.description: Make RPG Maker MV use OGG audio in every deployment instead of exporting a second M4A copy for mobile, Mac, and web builds.
features: Resolve audio files with the .ogg extension in RPG Maker MV
Avoid maintaining duplicate OGG and M4A audio libraries
Use without settings or runtime configuration
Keep deployment behavior in one tiny, focused plugin
installation: Download FugsOnlyOggMV.js.
Place it in your project's js/plugins folder.
Add FugsOnlyOggMV in RPG Maker MV's Plugin Manager and turn it on.
Deploy with your OGG audio files; no plugin settings are required.

plugins.name: Fugs OGG Opus Loop Tags
plugins.description: Makes RMMV/MZ read and use loop tags from OGG files with the Opus codec.
features: Read loop metadata from Opus-encoded OGG files
Works with RPG Maker MV and MZ audio playback
No extra audio tools required once loop tags are in the file
installation: Download FugsOpusMVMZ.js.
Place it in your project's js/plugins folder.
Enable it in the Plugin Manager.
Use OGG/Opus files with loop tags in your audio folders.

plugins.name: Fugs YEP/Galv SpriteOffset Fix
plugins.description: Fixes SpriteOffsetX errors when using Yanfly Sprite Offset with Galv Camera Control.
features: Resolves SpriteOffsetX conflicts between YEP and Galv plugins
Drop-in fix for common MV plugin stacks
installation: Download the plugin .js file.
Place it in js/plugins.
Enable it in the Plugin Manager (order may matter relative to YEP/Galv).

plugins.name: Fugs Chat Bubbles
plugins.description: Customizable animated speech bubbles that follow events and stack — Pixi-only parallel chat, themes, gradients, and FF7-style look for RPG Maker MV.
features: Parallel chat bubbles using Pixi only
Bubble stacking for multiple messages
Bounce-in and fade-out animations
Built-in themes plus custom gradient text and backgrounds
Bubbles can follow events, the player, or followers
Works with MBS Maps zoom (and similar camera plugins)
installation: Download FugsChatBubbles.js (or the release zip when available).
Place it in your project's js/plugins folder.
Enable FugsChatBubbles in Plugin Manager and pick a theme.
Use ShowChatBubble [event][duration][message] from events.
